about_item: SCIENTIFIC DESIGN: Our dog bed adopts a U-shaped design, providing the best support, comfort, and security. Three 3.5-inch side pillows provide perfect support for the dog's head, neck, and joints. And the fabric of this orthopedic dog bed is durable and not easy to tear. There are also anti slip small rubber dots on the bottom of the Oxford cloth, which can withstand your dog's mischievous antics while maintaining its shape and structure over time

EGG CRATE ORTHOPEDIC FOAM：Our pet bed use egg crate orthopedic foam of high density. It helps relieve pressure on joints and muscles, promoting better sleep and overall well-being. It's perfect for dogs of all ages, especially those with arthritis or mobility issues

WATERPROOF & EASY TO CLEAN: Don't worry about dogs wetting the dog couch, because there is a waterproof layer under the plush surface of the dog sofa, which can prevent liquid leakage and fully protect egg foam. The washable dog bed cover is easy to remove, just it into the washing machine, quickly making it look fresh and clean

MULTIPLE SIZES FOR YOU TO CHOOSE FROM: Medium dog bed can be used for dogs and all age cats under 35 LB.Large dog bed can be used for large dogs under 60 LB. XL Large dog bed can be used for large dogs under 90 LB. XXL Large dog bed can be used for large dogs under 100 LB. XXXL extra large dog bed can be used for extra large dogs under 110 LB. Please refer to our suggested weight and size to choose the bed suitable for your pets

SUPERIOR QUALITY- We are so confident in the quality of our dog bed that we offer a 30 day return plan! If you are not satisfied with the waterproof dog bed or have any questions,please feel free to contact us.We will definitely solve the problem for you

authors_reviews.title: Doggy approved
authors_reviews.text: I spent a lot of time researching dog beds, and this one is absolutely worth it. The memory foam is thick and supportive my dog used to toss and turn, but now she curls right up and sleeps through the night. The bolstered edges are great for her to rest her head on, and the cover zips off easily for washing (a big plus!).The material feels durable and high quality, and it still looks brand new after several washes. I also like that it doesn’t lose its shape like some cheaper beds do. It’s comfortable, easy to clean, and really well made definitely one of the best purchases I’ve made for my dog.Highly recommend for anyone looking for a cozy, long-lasting bed their dog will actually use! 🐶💤
authors_reviews.author: Olya

authors_reviews.title: Replacement Bed
authors_reviews.text: We bought this bed for our aging pitty girl to replace her old bed that had seen better days. The features that caught our eye was the ballasts on the sides and back and the orthopedic support. Her old bed also had the ballasts and she used them as pillows, so it was important that a new bed also had them. The bed came all “shrunken” in a small box, but took no time at all to “inflate” and reach full size. It was easy to assemble and the fabric seems to be high quality that should be pretty durable. I appreciate that the cover can be easily zipped off to wash. The only negative point is that the bed makes a crunching sound when the dog walks on it, which is due to the waterproof material covering the main mattress. I like that it’s waterproof, but it seems to annoy the dog sometimes. I think she gets too warm at times because of the waterproof cover as well. Overall, it’s an excellent dog bed though.
authors_reviews.author: Cathy M.
